headline:
Basic Heavy
20m
caption:
Basic Heavy 20m. 5 rounds, one heavy bell.

6 swings
5 cleans
4 reverse lunges
3 push press
6 marches
Switch sides every round.

No warm-up circuit, no finisher. Pick a bell you can press 3 to 6 times and get to work.

headline:
RKC
Deep 6
moves: Pull it to the rack on the way down; the bell never swings free overhead.
Hips throw the bell. Arms are rope.
Clean quiet, press strict. If it bangs your wrist, open your hand sooner.
Elbow stays glued to your ribs. Sit between your heels, not back.
Eyes on the bell until you're standing. Slow is the point.
save_line: Run all five on one side without setting the bell down, then switch. 3–5 rounds, rest 1–2 min.
caption:
RKC Deep 6. One side, no putting the bell down, then the other.

5 half snatches
5 single-arm swings
5 clean + press
5 racked squats
5 Turkish get-ups
Switch sides. Rest 1–2 min. 3–5 rounds.

The get-ups at the end are where the grip goes. Go lighter than you think and keep it clean.

#kettlebell #garagegym #kettlebellworkout #homeworkout #subthirtykb

10 minute cardio blast. Two bells, one of each, on repeat.

1 double row
1 double hang clean
1 double swing
1 double snatch
1 double thruster
1 double push press
As many rounds as you can in 10.

It's one rep each so you never put the bells down. That's the whole trick.

#kettlebell #garagegym #kettlebellworkout #homeworkout #subthirtykb

line_a: The swing is a hinge, not a squat.
line_b: Your hips throw the bell; your arms just hold on.
caption:
If your swings feel like a shoulder workout, you're lifting the bell. Snap the hips and let it float.

#kettlebell #garagegym #kettlebellworkout #homeworkout #subthirtykb

headline:
Hells
Bells
caption:
Hells Bells. 6 rounds, about 15 minutes, one heavy bell.

4 snatches
4 windmills
4 racked front squats
Switch sides every round.

Three moves. The windmills are what make it; don't rush them to get back to the fun part.

#kettlebell #garagegym #kettlebellworkout #homeworkout #subthirtykb

headline:
18m
AMRAP
moves: Bell starts dead on the floor every rep. No bounce.
Hand-to-hand at the top of the swing. Count total, not per side.
Swing it back, row it in. Elbow drives past the ribs.
8 each leg. Back knee kisses the floor, chest stays tall.
save_line: As many rounds as you can in 18 minutes. Medium or heavy; the bell that lets you keep moving.
caption:
18m AMRAP. One bell, 18 minutes, as many rounds as you can.

8 deadman to thruster
16 tactical cleans
16 ballistic rows
16 goblet lunges

Write your rounds on the garage wall. Beat it next time.

#kettlebell #garagegym #kettlebellworkout #homeworkout #subthirtykb

10-minute EMOM. One medium bell, start the clock.

Odd minutes: 12 swings
Even minutes: 8 goblet squats + 4 push-ups
Rest whatever's left of the minute.

If you're done in 25 seconds, the bell is too light. If you're not done by 50, it's too heavy.

#kettlebell #garagegym #kettlebellworkout #homeworkout #subthirtykb

Twenty minutes in the garage beats the hour you were going to find.

#kettlebell #garagegym #kettlebellworkout #homeworkout #subthirtykb

headline:
Sets
of 3
caption:
Sets of 3. One bell, 7 rounds, everything in threes.

3 cleans
3 push press
3 racked front squats
3 halos
3 curls
Then the other side. That's one round.

Low reps so you can go a little heavier than you'd pick for a complex. Credit @rclivestrongfit.

#kettlebell #garagegym #kettlebellworkout #homeworkout #subthirtykb

headline:
Back to
basics
moves: Squat drives the press. Don't press until your hips are open.
Keep it close. The bell should barely leave your body on the way up.
Breathe out hard at the top. Stand tall, squeeze, repeat.
Press as you stand out of the lunge, not after.
save_line: 30s work, 30s rest. 4 rounds, rest 30s between rounds. Medium or heavy.
caption:
Back to basics. 30 on, 30 off, 4 rounds, one bell.

Thruster (30s each side)
Clean (30s each side)
Two-hand swing (30s)
Lunge and press (30s each side)
Rest 30s between rounds.

Nothing new here. Four moves you already know, done with a clock so you can't coast.

#kettlebell #garagegym #kettlebellworkout #homeworkout #subthirtykb

Heavy 5-3-2. The heaviest bell you own, 5 rounds, under 10 minutes.

5 swings
3 cleans
2 presses
Switch hands. That's a round.

Rest as much as you need between rounds. This is strength work, not cardio; the clock is just a cap.

#kettlebell #garagegym #kettlebellworkout #homeworkout #subthirtykb

line_b: A loose grip is a loose press.
caption:
Squeeze the handle like you're trying to leave fingerprints in it. The whole arm fires and the press gets lighter.
